edition: Current public SaaS help documentation; plan-specific differences recorded where documented

findings.summary: Page editing is block-based; the slash menu adds block types and invokes block actions.
Page sharing exposes member/group access, permission levels, links, web publishing, and access requests.
Databases support multiple independently configured views, including table, board, timeline, calendar, list, gallery and chart.
Changing the primary sign-in email adds and verifies a new address before making it primary; the old address is removed separately, and Enterprise policy may restrict aliases.
Pages can be moved or nested with sidebar drag-and-drop; moving shared content into Private removes others' access.
Deleted pages enter Trash, cannot be edited there, can be restored, and default to a 30-day Trash period with Enterprise customization.
The exact pending-invitation revocation behavior was not established by the reviewed public Notion help pages and requires authorized interface observation or additional primary documentation.
